name: misty-photorealistic-sauna-portrait
image_purpose: Create a cinematic wellness portrait in a premium Finnish sauna.

prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with a dewy natural complexion, long wet-look blonde hair, serene direct gaze, and realistic skin texture. She wears a securely wrapped white cotton bath towel with full coverage. Do not imitate or depict any real person.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 portrait. The subject sits on a polished cedar bench with ankles crossed, leaning slightly forward with relaxed shoulders and hands resting softly on the wood. Visible towel texture, water droplets, cedar grain, sauna stones, heater, and rising heat haze.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm diffused ambient lighting, soft under-bench glow, warm top light, gentle shadows, volumetric steam and golden haze creating a calm luxurious atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm prime-lens look, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on eyes, gradual background falloff, photorealistic detail, 8K look, vertical 9:16.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A cinematic photorealistic vertical wellness portrait of an original adult woman with long wet-look blonde hair and a serene direct gaze, seated on a polished Western Red Cedar bench in an ultra-luxury Finnish sauna. She is securely wrapped in a full-coverage white cotton bath towel with visible terry texture and small water droplets. Her ankles are crossed, shoulders relaxed, hands resting naturally on the wood. Cedar slats, sauna stones, stainless steel heater, rising steam, and volumetric mist surround the scene. Warm diffused ambient light and a subtle under-bench glow create soft golden haze. Sharp eyes, realistic skin texture, 35mm lens look, shallow depth of field, photorealistic 8K detail, vertical 9:16.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Adapt from the existing text prompt and folder/file naming only. Preserve the premium sauna wellness concept with secure towel coverage and an original adult subject.
